verdict.rationale: Roles and permissions for team members are a fair question for a business finance account, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of user roles, team-member permissions, or location- or department-level access. The card spending permissions and MCC/currency spend controls are adjacent card-level features, not user-role management, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can define granular user roles and permissions across team members, locations, and departments
